newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain-Soy offers remain lower, corn slips.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain-Soy offers remain lower, corn slips.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean offers remained weaker on Tuesday and corn values slipped by one cent a bushel in the nearby positions, dealers said.
Volatility of the August/November soybean spread and the continued gains in the Chicago Board of Trade soybean futures pressured FOB values, one dealer said.
Farm sales in both soybeans and corn remained sluggish, he said.
On the export front, Pakistan bought 500,000 tonnes of white wheat for August 11-September 10 shipment, the Pakistan embassy said.
The purchase included 200,000 tonnes of U.S. white wheat, 250,000 tonnes of Australian wheat and 50,000 tonnes of Canadian wheat.
